prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. A rainy evening in a grand 1930s marble bank lobby, the camera low on the wet marble floor just beside a huge open round vault door that glows warm gold from inside: the polished two-tone shoes and pinstripe trouser legs of three gangsters in pinstripe suits with heavy sacks over their shoulders, a fat one with a scar through his top lip, a thin bald one with big ears and a young one with slicked red hair and freckles pass close in the near foreground, a sack dragging, heading into the vault. An old white guard in a peaked cap with brass buttons stands by the door tipping his cap. Far back across the hall, small and off-centre, a loan desk under a green lamp where a thin young white clerk with centre-parted oiled hair and sleeve garters writes slowly while a heavy-set Black man in his fifties with a shaved head, a broken nose and a double chin, in a shabby brown suit two sizes too small, his hat in his hands waits on a hard chair. Tall rain-streaked windows glow cold blue; green-shaded banker's lamps sit on the desks; rain tracked in across the polished marble floor in puddles and bootprints. Most of the frame in shadow; the brightest values are the gold vault light and its streaks across the wet marble. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
